## Problem

Who needs this behavior, and what is difficult today?

## Proposed outcome

Describe an observable result and the expected user/operator flow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A concrete behavior that can be reviewed
- [ ] A relevant failure or permission boundary

## Dependencies and scope

Identify category/identity/approval policy, vendor contracts, schema changes or reviews needed. Keep requirements separate from a proposed implementation.
